summary: A Yes vote enacts a one-half-cent (0.5%) general sales tax in St. Helena, with revenue going to the city's general fund for city services.

tax.text: A Yes vote would establish a one-half cent local sales tax to support general City services.
tax.quote: If approved by voters, Measure S would establish a locally controlled one-half cent (0.5%) sales tax to support general City services.

tax.text: A No vote would not establish the proposed local sales tax.
